basic_details.short_information: Kalakshetra Recruitment 2026 is for one Librarian post (Group B, UR) at Besant Arundale Senior Secondary School, which belongs to Kalakshetra Foundation (कलाक्षेत्र प्रतिष्ठान). Kalakshetra Foundation is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India. Send your application by post on the Annexure-I proforma to the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai. It must reach the Director by 05.30 PM on 23 November 2026 (Monday). Applications sent by email will be rejected.

age_limit.details: The age limit is not more than 27 years as on the closing date, 23 November 2026. Kalakshetra Foundation accepts only the date of birth written in the application form and recorded in the Matriculation / Secondary Examination Certificate. No later request to change it will be considered. No relaxation in the upper age limit is available for departmental candidates. | Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the written test / skill test. The Foundation will publish the scheme of examination on its website later.

No correspondence will be entertained about the conduct and result of the test, or about why a candidate was not called for the test. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No travelling allowance is paid for attending the written test / skill test. If the process runs beyond one day, candidates must arrange their own travel and stay at Chennai. The declaration in the form states that the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled if information is found to be suppressed, false or incorrect, or if ineligibility is found before or after the examination. The decision of Kalakshetra Foundation is final in all matters, including eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and final selection. Any dispute about this recruitment will be subject to courts/tribunals having jurisdiction in Chennai.

content_sections.heading: About Kalakshetra Foundation
content_sections.text: Kalakshetra Foundation calls itself an Institution of National Importance. It is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India, and its postal address is Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041. Besant Arundale Senior Secondary School (BASS School), where the Librarian will work, is a school of the Foundation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by post only. Applications received through email, or received after the closing date, will be summarily rejected. Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma given in Annexure-I of the notification. Use a blue or black ball point pen. Paste one recent passport size photograph on the application form. Put one more passport size photograph in a cover. It will be fixed on the call letter. Sign the declaration and fill in the place and date. Attach self-attested copies of the testimonials (see Enclosures below). Write on the cover: "Application for the post of 'Librarian, BASS School'" . Send it by post to: The Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041. It must reach by 05.30 PM on 23 November 2026 (Monday). The application form asks for these details: Name in block letters, category, and mother's and father's names Address for communication and two mobile numbers Email address, Aadhar number (optional) and PAN Date of birth, and age as on the closing date (23-11-2026) Nationality and gender Educational qualifications from Class X onwards (Class X, Class XII, Graduation, Post-Graduation, BLIS, MLIS), each with the year of passing, marks % / CGPA and board/university Relevant experience in library management and related activities: the number of years, and for each job the institution, post, nature of duty and the from/to dates Knowledge of Indian languages (to speak, read and write) Why you consider yourself suitable for the post Any other information you wish to add FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Kalakshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is One (1) Librarian post at Besant Arundale Senior Secondary School, reserved as UR. The Foundation says the number may vary depending on the vacancies at the time of final selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Kalakshetra Librarian post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041 by 05.30 PM on 23 November 2026 (Monday). Late applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Kalakshetra Librarian post?
faq.answer: You need an MA and a Bachelor of Library Science, each from a recognised University or equivalent. You also need five years' experience in a library attached to a Central/State Govt institution or a special library of similar nature.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Kalakshetra Librarian post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 27 years as on the closing date, 23 November 2026. No relaxation in the upper age limit is available for departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Kalakshetra Librarian?
faq.answer: The Librarian post is in Pay Level 6 of the 7th CPC (Rs 35400 - 112400). It is a Group B post.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for Kalakshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-I proforma with a blue or black ball point pen and attach self-attested copies of your testimonials. Then post it to the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041, in a cover marked "Application for the post of 'Librarian, BASS School'".

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for the Kalakshetra Librarian post by email?
faq.answer: No. Applications received through email will be summarily rejected. The application must be sent by post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Kalakshetra Librarian post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test / skill test, and merit is based on the combined score. Ties are decided first by age (older candidate higher) and then by alphabetical order.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications for the Kalakshetra Librarian post?
faq.answer: The desirable qualifications are a Master degree in Library Science from a recognised University and knowledge of Library automation. The others are the ability to read and understand Sanskrit and other south Indian languages, and the ability to read music notations.

faq.question: Q10. Is travelling allowance paid for the Kalakshetra written test or skill test?
faq.answer: No. No travelling allowance is payable for attending the written test / skill test. If the process runs beyond one day, candidates must arrange their own travel and stay at Chennai.
